subject: Eval stipend request & timeline for VertexHealth RFP (RFP-0427)

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval stipend request — VertexHealth RFP-0427

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick product overview earlier. As part of our RFP timeline for procurement, we need to run a short bake-off across three vendors next month. Can Redwood provide an evaluation stipend / trial allocation so our ML infra team can run a benchmark (inference latency and cost) against our incumbent?

Scope: 2 week head-to-head, ~100k input tokens (mixed-length clinical notes), and ability to run 50 concurrent small requests.

Deliverables we need:
- Token allotment for model evals
- A short term trial window (preferably 60–90 days)
- Priority onboarding support for test setup (shared Slack channel or Zoom)

We have an initial SOW attached that details the bake-off technical requirements. Could you confirm what you can offer and any eligibility conditions for promotional credits?

Attachments: Vertex_Bakeoff_SOW.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Samantha
Procurement, VertexHealth

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700

Aditya: can you share a baseline stipend we typically allocate for RFP bake-offs of this scale, and what support we can commit to in the 60–90 day window?

Samantha — appreciate the details. Quick proposal from Redwood to enable the bake-off:

- Eval stipend: 75,000 input tokens pre-provisioned (can be used across models in our catalog)
- Trial window: 45 days active trial from first API call (we can extend upon request with approvals)
- Onboarding: 3 hours dedicated onboarding with Neha + priority Slack channel for troubleshooting
- Success criteria: we provide token-level cost breakdown and latency sampling to match your SOW metrics

Attachments: redwood_eval_offer_75k_tokens.pdf (pdf) — draft offer letter and usage terms.

If you need a 60–90 day committed window or additional tokens to mirror production traffic, let us know the exact ask and I will route for an authorization if necessary.

Next steps: please confirm that the stipend and 45-day trial are sufficient and whether you require an NDA or governance paperwork before we provision.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Aditya — thanks for the quick proposal. A few follow-ups:

1) The 75k tokens are a good start, but our baseline runs will need ~200k to exercise the end-to-end pipelines we outlined in the SOW. Can you bridge to that amount?
2) For procurement purposes we prefer a 90-day active window so our security and infra teams can complete load testing.
3) Priority onboarding is critical. Would you be able to assign a technical lead during the first week of the trial?

We can sign a mutual NDA within 48 hours if that helps speed provisioning.

Thanks,
Daniel Wong
CTO, VertexHealth

Operationally, 200k tokens and a 90-day window are both possible but require approval for an increased promotional allocation.

Priyom — can you advise on what we need to authorize a one-off 200k token stipend and a 90-day trial? Any standard addenda or paperwork we should attach?

Team — I reviewed the request. Authorization notes:

- One-time promotional allowance up to 250k tokens is approved for strategic RFPs when matched to an active pipeline deal (deal_id VX-2027-0427 qualifies).
- 90-day trial window is acceptable provided we execute a trial addendum that limits production usage and includes standard audit clauses.
- Requirement: VertexHealth must sign the trial addendum and a short NDA (we have templates).

I'll prepare the trial addendum and attach the legal templates. Once signed, we can provision 200k tokens and schedule Neha's technical lead for onboarding.
